assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: The scan's verdict; set only when `status` is `completed`. A `warn` can mean a `fail` that was allowed in claude.ai.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The primary mechanism behind a `warn` or `fail`, such as `credential-exposure` or `guardrail-tampering`; a mechanism this API does not yet name reads as `other`. Read `status` first: on an `errored` scan it is not a finding but why there is no verdict: `scan-invalid-archive`, the scan refused the version's archive, or could not process it, before checking what its files say, and running it again will not help, so change the files and store a new version; `scan-did-not-finish`, the scan did not finish or its result is no longer available, so retry the scan in claude.ai if it offers a retry; `scan-unavailable`, the scan could not run or its result cannot be read right now, so read the version again later, then retry the scan in claude.ai if it offers a retry. If these steps do not help, contact support. Null on a `pass`, while a scan runs, and when no mechanism is reported for the verdict. On an errored scan, null means that a compliance configuration ruled out the scan.

status.title: Status
status.description: `processing` while a scan runs, `completed` when it ran to completion, `errored` when it could not run. Once a scan of the version has completed, `content_scan` describes the newest completed scan, even while a later scan runs. While the scan outcome cannot be read, `status` is `errored` instead.
